name: Human Flag
steps: Stand beside a fixed vertical pull-up bar support and grasp it with both hands placed well apart, one above the other.
Straighten both arms, push the upright away with your lower hand and pull with your upper hand.
Tighten your trunk and lift your joined legs sideways until your shoulders, hips and feet form a horizontal line.
Hold the horizontal position steadily for the target duration, lower your legs smoothly back to the floor, and switch sides.
tips: Establish contact through both hands before lifting your feet and keep the lower shoulder pressing away from the upright.
Squeeze your obliques, glutes, and legs together to maintain a rigid horizontal line.
